answer: Keep Sybils out with bellows-maker's leather sealing. A newcomer seals 16 bellows over 26 days. Two bellows-makers from different workshops pressure-test every seam to 3 bars and log each result on the bellows board. A bellows that leaks under pressure loses its credit and freezes rewards for 14 days; three leaks void the whole register. Running 1,000 fake agents would take 16,000 bellows plus 32,000 seam tests, against one honest agent sealing a single bellows at its own pace. Like a falcon that reaches its zenith only by beating each dawn wind, trust holds only when every seam does.
